full_prompt_en: A square architectural photograph shows a vast symmetrical pale stone courtyard enclosed by walls of repeated square openings. The viewpoint sits on the central axis at ground level, looking toward a smaller far wall beneath a bright overcast sky. On both sides, tall gray-white facades rise out of the frame, their identical dark window recesses stacking in even rows and shrinking with distance. The end wall repeats the same square grid, with an open central doorway at the bottom. Below the upper facades, deep colonnades run along the left and right sides. Their broad rectangular supports make a second, larger rhythm at pedestrian level, with warm lamps placed at regular intervals near the base. The floor is paved in large pale rectangular slabs, softly reflective where light grazes it. A few tiny people stand or walk near the far center and along the right arcade, giving the courtyard a strong sense of scale without crowding it. The sky is almost white and diffuse, leaving no hard direction to the daylight. Soft light washes the stone evenly, while each recessed window and column bay remains dark gray. The warm lamp glows add small amber notes at the lower edges and faintly color the paving nearby. Fine stone grain and seam lines remain visible, but the repeated geometry dominates over surface detail. No signage or readable text appears. The overall composition is severe and calm, using one-point perspective, equal side walls, square rhythm, and tiny human scale to make the empty center feel monumental.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形建筑摄影呈现一座宽阔对称的浅色石质中庭，四周墙面重复排列方形开口。视点位于地面的中央轴线上，望向明亮阴天下面较小的远墙。两侧，高大的灰白立面升出画幅，完全相同的深色窗洞整齐叠成行列，并随距离缩小。尽头墙重复相同方格，下方中央开着一道门。在上层立面下方，深柱廊沿左右两边伸展。宽阔矩形支柱在行人层建立第二种更大的节奏，暖灯按规律设在柱脚附近。地面由大型浅色矩形石板铺成，被光掠过处微微反射。几名极小的人在远处中央和右侧柱廊站立或行走，强烈标明中庭尺度，却不使其拥挤。天空近乎白色，光漫射，没有硬日光方向。柔光均匀洗过石面，各个凹窗与柱间仍保持深灰色。暖灯在下方两侧添入小块琥珀光，并轻微染亮附近铺地。细石颗粒和接缝仍可见，但重复几何压过表面细节。没有招牌或可读文字。整体构图严峻而平静，以单点透视、相等的侧墙、方格节奏和细小人体尺度，使空阔中央显得雄伟。
style_prompt_en: The photograph relies on rigorous one-point perspective, bilateral balance, and repeated square modules. Pale stone and cool gray occupy most of the frame, while dark recesses create a regular checker rhythm and small warm glows anchor the base. Diffuse sky light gives broad planes even tone and suppresses harsh cast shadows; depth comes mainly from diminishing repetition and the contrast of openings. A wide uncluttered central plane amplifies the scale of surrounding forms. Fine seams and grain remain subordinate to the strict grid. The overall effect is austere, serene, and monumental, with proportion and repetition as the strongest visual mechanism.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅摄影依赖严格的单点透视、两侧平衡和重复方形模数。浅石色与冷灰占画面大部，深色凹处构成规律棋盘节奏，下方由小面积暖光稳住。漫射天光使大平面色调均匀，压住强硬投影；纵深主要来自逐渐缩小的重复和开口对比。宽阔不拥挤的中央平面放大周围形体尺度。细接缝与颗粒从属于严格网格。整体效果严谨、宁静而雄伟，比例与重复是最强的视觉机制。
theme_en: A symmetrical pale stone courtyard with repeating square openings
theme_zh: 带重复方形开口的对称浅石色中庭
name: David Chipperfield
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
